dirty_tracker.token: maximum dirty revision among cells inside exact inclusive coverage
dirty_tracker.outside_rule: a dirty cell outside exact coverage must not change its token, including when it shares a storage section
dirty_tracker.inside_rule: every dirty cell inside coverage must advance its token
dirty_tracker.bulk_rule: chunk unload or equivalent range invalidation marks every affected covered cell dirty
dirty_tracker.authoritative_rule: the Minecraft adapter must report every block mutation and chunk load-state transition that can affect captured geometry

cache.hit_rule: reuse the same immutable complete snapshot instance
cache.rebuild_rule: coverage, halo or dirty-token mismatch rebuilds synchronously
cache.concurrent_dirty_rule: dirty-token change between scan start and publication discards all geometry
cache.generation_rule: FrozenBlockView generation still protects mutation during a rebuild; coverage dirty token is authoritative for cache hits
cache.world_change_rule: replacing the tracker identity invalidates the cache even when bounds, halo and numeric token are unchanged

fixtures: outside dirty in same storage section preserves hit
dirty during capture publishes empty incomplete geometry
bulk chunk-unload invalidation changes overlapping tokens
